scope: Inspection scheduling change only; native qualification independent.
observation: Prior recovery made 165 synchronous native pose queries within 120 wall seconds. Late alignment samples were within 0.2m/0.1rad, but map TF freshness intermittently failed. Synchronous calls stop this probe executor from processing subscriptions; reducing query frequency leaves time to consume real ROS callbacks. No assertion that this is a defect in the underlying mapping producer.
change: At most one native query per wall second; health, speed, anchor and map freshness still checked on every wait iteration. Only a fresh actual native query can finish the continuous interval. After-query reference and real receipt ages retained.
